tool_args.rationale: The base-field, sink-gradient, and transient-lag signatures favor the siphon-memory ODE. The trajectory batch adds observations to constrain its five parameters before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint measurements at similar horizons provide no redundancy and may poorly separate fast memory relaxation from coupling strength.
Neither model accounts for the observed coupled transient lag or uses the initial memory state.
The auxiliary measurement does not discriminate between the candidate dynamics.
